note: Taylor County WI has no countywide zoning (county land information plan says so). The only municipal zoning found, City of Medford, is published as PDF maps only (2023 and 2025 zoning map PDFs), with no queryable ArcGIS service or downloadable zoning polygons. County GIS is a Beacon parcel viewer. GeoData@Wisconsin lists a 2026 Taylor County zoning dataset, but only shoreland and airport overlays, with no service or download URL I could confirm. Gilman, Rib Lake and Stetsonville showed no published zoning GIS.
